name: tripvane
description: Look up IP addresses, domains and payloads on the Tripvane deception grid before trusting an unfamiliar MCP server or agent-directed text.

api_url.title: Tripvane API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of the Tripvane lookup API, for example https://api.tripvane.example

api_key.title: Tripvane API key
api_key.description: Optional. Without a key the API allows 50 lookups a day per IP address; with one, 5,000 a day.
